symptom: The trained mid-path-retention probe converted caramel-workshop seed 63407 from parent defeat at 218.5177s to victory at 300.0150s and improved the 10 seed caramel target follow-up win rate from 0.0 to 0.1, but it failed same-seed high-pressure parent preservation. The fixed-window validator reported policy_window_regression_failed with 3 blockers: 60s/caramel-workshop win_rate_delta -0.3334, 180s/cracked-star-jar action_distribution_l1_delta 0.4646, and 300s/caramel-workshop action_distribution_l1_delta 0.5872.
root_cause: The single-seed 256 timestep continuation successfully learned part of the 60-180s path-retention signal for seed 63407, but it shifted online action distributions and short-window behavior enough to reopen earlier regressions. It still fails seed 63402 in the opening window, regresses seed 63405 in the 10 seed caramel follow-up, and reduces 60s caramel-workshop high-pressure win rate against the parent.
fix: Do not continue training or promote this checkpoint. Treat it only as evidence that 60-180s path retention is a useful training objective. The next repair should separate seed 63402 opening repair from seed 63407 mid-path retention, add 60s caramel-workshop hard preflight or training-time early stop, and rerun both 10 seed target follow-up and 60/180/300s high-pressure parent no-regression.
